title.narrative: Output 1.2. Increased institutional capacity of workers’ organizations

description.narrative:
In April 2020, the Kuwait Trade Union Federation (KTUF) established a legal support unit for its migrant workers' office to support migrant workers with legal protection, legal awareness and training to volunteers and migrant workers.
KTUF developed a trade union communication strategy to improve its outreach to all workers, including migrants and the public at large. This included printed brochures in different languages (Arabic, English, French, 2 Indian, Tagalog, Srilankan, Bangladeshi, and Nepali) to secure reaching out to the majority of migrant workers in all economic sectors.
KTUF issued a new strategic workplan for 2021 to meet the new challenges in light of the political development in Kuwait. ILO provided KTUF with financial and technical assistance to offer legal assistance to migrant workers.
In May 2020, ILO supported KTUF in conducting capacity building workshops for the 22 members of the migrant workers office team on the Kuwait Domestic Workers Law No. 68/2015 and “Psychological Consequences Ramifications of COVID-19 Epidemic on workers and the Kuwait Penalty Law”.
KTUF financially and technically supported to launch awareness campaigns concerning COVID-19, legal issues, and OSH.
ILO organized virtual training on trade union communication for 20 trade union leaders and communication officers (including 5 women) to enhance the organization's communication outreach to all workers, engage in the promotion and implementation of the Decent Work Country Porgramme (DWCP) and to respond to the COVID-19 crisis. The two phases workshop (27-29 July 2020 and 27-28 July 2021), supported the development of a trade union communication strategy to be endorsed by the KTUF executive board. ILO technically supported KTUF to hold a strategic planning meeting in March 2021.
ILO supported KTUF to build the capacity of its leaders, through regional webinars/trainings implemented for the Arab Trade Union Organizations in May, June, July and December 2020, and in February, June, and July 2021. The activities focused on the Impact of COVID-19 on workers and the role of trade unions during the crisis.

description.narrative:
The Kuwait Trade Union Federation (KTUF) actively participate in the tripartite meeting organized to validate the Kuwait social dialogue report in June 2020.
KTUF successfully influenced the tripartite labor Affairs Counsulting Committee to ban discrimination at work through the issuance of decision number 177 on Sep 26, 2021 by the Public Authority of Manpower, banning discrimination in employment in the private sector and prohibiting sexual harassment in the workplace. Through ILO technical support, KTUF leaders contributed to the scoping and assessment study on collective bargaining.
ILO provided KTUF with technical assistance to participate in the tripartite meeting organized to validate the Kuwait social dialogue report in June 2020.
Through regional webinars/trainings organized for the Arab Trade Union Organizations, ILO support the KTUF to build capacity of its leaders, focussing on the Impact of COVID-19 on workers and the role of trade unions during the crisis.
